_doc: clinic-patient-declarative — the patient card is a declarative WebMCP form (2026-09-02).
For a person who cannot type: the browser publishes the card as clinic_patient_details, the
assistant fills it from what it knows, the person's own press on Save is the consent. A fill the
browser did not attribute to the person shows the 'Filled in by your assistant' banner; a submit
that is not the person's is refused and counted; a trusted Save stores the record.
The browser sees a tool: toolname on the form, a description on every field.
An assistant's fill (not the person's keystrokes) is shown as such.
